name: Gamified
tagline: Chunky pressable controls, a violet action color and gold rewards.
description: A playful, tactile component style. Panes and controls have thick 2px edges and a hard bottom ledge, so buttons press down when clicked like keys on a game pad. Titles, buttons and numbers are set in Fredoka, body text in Nunito. Violet carries actions, selection and focus; gold marks rewards, live states and the current item; green fills progress like an XP bar. Every component ships light and a deep-violet dark, with every interactive state, built on native elements.
